system.description:
The thaumaturge marshals wind and water together, driving up a full storm of lashing rain and howling gusts across the surrounding miles.

Storm combines the effects of Rain or Snow and High Winds at once. To change the weather, spend a Willpower Trait, decide how quickly the change comes and spend Mental Traits accordingly (from one Trait for six hours up to five Traits for near-instant, which risks a Masquerade breach), then win a Static Mental Challenge against the Storyteller. Visibility is badly impaired, so those spotting by normal sight bid four extra Traits (two with Auspex); ranged attackers bid two to three extra Traits; and you may knock a victim in the open off their feet with a Mental Challenge against their Physical Traits, costing them a turn to rise. Retest with Occult.
system.duration: Minutes to a day depending on Traits spent
